# All publications

::: {#pubs-root}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {

  function normalize(s){ return (s||"").toLowerCase(); }
  function escapeRegExp(str){ return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }

  const YOUR_FULL = [
    "alexander buritica",
    "alexander buriticá",
    "buritica, alexander",
    "buriticá, alexander",
    "buritica casanova, alexander",
    "buritica-casanova, alexander"
  ];
  const YOUR_LAST = ["buritica","buriticá","buritica-casanova","buritica casanova"];

  function getYear(el){
    const t = el.textContent || "";
    const m = t.match(/\b(19|20)\d{2}\b/);
    return m ? m[0] : "Other";
  }

  function findLinks(el){
    const links = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll("a")).filter(a => a.href);
    const doi    = links.find(a => /doi\.org\//i.test(a.href));
    const pdf    = links.find(a => /\.pdf(\?|$)/i.test(a.href) || normalize(a.textContent).includes("pdf"));
    const code   = links.find(a => /github\.com|gitlab\.com|bitbucket\.org/i.test(a.href));
    const slides = links.find(a => /\.(ppt|pptx)(\?|$)/i.test(a.href) || normalize(a.textContent).includes("slides"));
    return { doi, pdf, code, slides };
  }

  function hideQuartoReferences(){
    // Oculta el bloque final "References" (varía según theme)
    const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("h2, h1"));
    const refHeading = headings.find(h => normalize(h.textContent).trim() === "references");
    if (refHeading) {
      // Oculta el título
      refHeading.style.display = "none";

      // Oculta el contenedor #refs si existe (sin afectar pubs-root)
      const refs = document.querySelector("#refs");
      if (refs) refs.style.display = "none";

      // A veces hay wrappers alrededor, intentamos ocultar su sección
      const section = refHeading.closest("section");
      if (section) section.style.display = "none";
    } else {
      // Fallback: si no se encontró el título, al menos oculta #refs visualmente
      const refs = document.querySelector("#refs");
      if (refs) refs.style.display = "none";
    }
  }

  function enhancePublications(){
    const refs = document.querySelector("#refs");
    const root = document.querySelector("#pubs-root");
    if (!refs || !root) return false;

    const entries = Array.from(refs.querySelectorAll(".csl-entry"));
    if (!entries.length) return false;

    // Quita links "DOI" sueltos generados por CSL
    entries.forEach(e => {
      Array.from(e.querySelectorAll("a")).forEach(a => {
        if (normalize(a.textContent).trim() === "doi") a.remove();
      });
    });

    // Group by year
    const groups = {};
    entries.forEach(e => {
      const y = getYear(e);
      (groups[y] ||= []).push(e);
    });

    const years = Object.keys(groups)
      .filter(y => y !== "Other")
      .sort((a,b) => parseInt(b) - parseInt(a));
    if (groups["Other"]) years.push("Other");

    // Build clean layout into pubs-root
    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.className = "pubs-clean";

    years.forEach(y => {
      const sec = document.createElement("section");
      sec.className = "pub-year-section";

      const h = document.createElement("h3");
      h.className = "pub-year";
      h.textContent = y;
      sec.appendChild(h);

      const list = document.createElement("ul");
      list.className = "pub-list-clean";

      groups[y].forEach(entry => {
        const e = entry.cloneNode(true);

        // Bold your name
        let html = e.innerHTML;
        YOUR_FULL.forEach(k => {
          html = html.replace(new RegExp(`\\b(${escapeRegExp(k)})\\b`, "gi"), "<strong>$1</strong>");
        });
        YOUR_LAST.forEach(k => {
          html = html.replace(new RegExp(`\\b(${escapeRegExp(k)})\\b`, "gi"), "<strong>$1</strong>");
        });
        e.innerHTML = html;

        // Bold journal (keep italics)
        const jEl = e.querySelector("i, em");
        if (jEl && jEl.textContent) {
          jEl.innerHTML = "<strong>" + jEl.textContent + "</strong>";
        }

        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.className = "pub-item-clean";

        const cite = document.createElement("div");
        cite.className = "pub-cite";
        cite.appendChild(e);

        // Actions
        const links = findLinks(e);
        const actions = document.createElement("div");
        actions.className = "pub-actions-clean";

        function addAction(label, aTag){
          if (!aTag) return;
          const a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = aTag.href;
          a.target = "_blank";
          a.rel = "noopener";
          a.textContent = label;
          actions.appendChild(a);
        }

        addAction("PDF", links.pdf);
        addAction("Code", links.code);
        addAction("Slides", links.slides);

        li.appendChild(cite);
        if (actions.childNodes.length) li.appendChild(actions);

        list.appendChild(li);
      });

      sec.appendChild(list);
      container.appendChild(sec);
    });

    root.innerHTML = "";
    root.appendChild(container);

    hideQuartoReferences();
    return true;
  }

  function boot(){
    if (enhancePublications()) return;
    let tries = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      tries += 1;
      if (enhancePublications() || tries > 60) clearInterval(timer); // ~6s
    }, 100);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  } else {
    boot();
  }

})();
</script>
```
